d: The Accountant is responsible for accurately recording daily financial transactions and managing receipts, payments, expenses, and payroll. The role includes executing bank transfers, preparing monthly and closing entries, maintaining secure and organized financial records, and ensuring the accuracy and integrity of accounting entries. The Accountant is also responsible for reconciling customer, bank, and supplier balances and resolving any discrepancies.
Accurately record all daily financial transactions.
Process and record receipts and payments on a daily basis.
Record daily expenses and prepare payroll statements.
Execute bank transfers and monitor banking operations.
Prepare monthly accounting entries and closing entries.
Maintain secure, organized, and accessible financial records.
Ensure the accuracy and integrity of all accounting entries.
Conduct periodic reconciliations of customer, bank, and supplier balances to identify and resolve discrepancies.
q: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting or an equivalent qualification.

d: Helps protect Circlys and its customers from fraud and regulatory breaches by leading day-to-day fraud detection and investigation, from alert review and case management to tuning detection rules. The role also supports compliance monitoring, policy updates, and SAMA audits and inspections, and works with the Risk Department to strengthen fraud controls, report on fraud trends, and build fraud awareness. Decisions and approvals remain with the Head of Compliance and AFC.
q: Education: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Risk Management, Information Systems, Law or Business Administration.
Experience: Fresh graduate holding a relevant certification, or up to 2 years of experience in regulatory compliance, fraud or AML, preferably in banking or fintech.
Certifications (preferred): Certified Compliance Officer (CCO), Certified Fraud Examiner (CFE) or Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist (CAMS).
Skills: Knowledge of SAMA regulations, data analysis in Excel, investigation and report writing, confidentiality, and good Arabic and English.
Attributes: Excellent communication, a proactive and practical approach, and the ability to contribute to the development of the Department’s processes and the systems it uses.
r: Carry out compliance monitoring reviews across departments, and follow up the corrective actions.
Review and update policies and procedures, and track the SAMA requirements that affect them.
Support internal and external audits and regulatory inspections, and follow up their findings.
Review fraud alerts daily, and register and investigate fraud cases in the fraud case register.
Escalate suspected fraud in line with the escalation procedures.
Test fraud detection scenarios and support their tuning, including threshold and rule adjustments.
Maintain the Fraud Risk Register with the Risk Department, and prepare the monthly fraud management information report.
Prepare fraud awareness content for customers and employees.
